shape: Square panel meter (72x72mm HS-72B) or DIN-rail modular enclosure
scale_info: 5 integer digits (black background) + 1 decimal tenths digit (white/red background)
indicator_type: Dual/Single mechanical cyclometer roller drums (non-resettable TOTAL TIME & resettable TIME)
prompt:
You are inspecting an INDUSTRIAL OPERATING HOUR METER (運転時間計) or ENERGY METER.
CRITICAL DUAL-COUNTER RULES (e.g. Mitsubishi HS-72B):
1. COUNTER ARCHITECTURE:
   Industrial hour meters frequently feature TWO separate mechanical cyclometer drum registers:
   - ROW 1 (UPPER REGISTER) - "TOTAL TIME": Cumulative non-resettable operating hours since initial commissioning. Read all 5 black integer digits and the final decimal tenths digit (e.g., 0-2-6-7-.6 -> 267.6 h).
   - ROW 2 (LOWER REGISTER) - "TIME" (Trip/Session): Resettable operating hours for maintenance intervals or operating shifts, equipped with a manual knurled reset knob at the bottom center. Read all 5 black integer digits and decimal tenths digit (e.g., 0-2-5-7-.9 -> 257.9 h).
2. DETECTION PROTOCOL:
   - POINTERS NOT REQUIRED: Since this is a roller drum counter, set needles: [].
   - MULTI-REGISTER EXTRACTION: Detect BOTH counter rows as distinct gauge objects in the gauges array:
     * Gauge #1: label: "Mitsubishi Hour Meter (TOTAL TIME)", reading.value: 267.6, reading.formatted: "TOTAL: 267.6 h", numbers: all detected digits of row 1.
     * Gauge #2: label: "Mitsubishi Hour Meter (TIME / Trip)", reading.value: 257.9, reading.formatted: "TRIP: 257.9 h", numbers: all detected digits of row 2.
   - If detected as a single combined gauge, report formatted: "TOTAL: 267.6 h | TRIP: 257.9 h" and include digits from BOTH rows in numbers.
3. MANDATORY AI REASONING & DERIVATION (reading.reasoning):
   - Clearly explain both lines: Upper register represents non-resettable cumulative "TOTAL TIME", while lower register represents resettable "TIME" with the manual reset knob.
